sources.finding: An upstream user reports multi-model hangs on driver 5540 on Lunar Lake. Later controlled updates retract the initial claim that turbo or keeping the NPU busy prevents the problem: failures continue with turbo, disabled idle pruning, and continuous submissions. Different processor and workload; this does not establish our root cause.
The NPU plugin documents multiple infer requests per compiled model and a turbo property. API support alone does not validate this renderer workload.

action: Preserve the failed experiment and confirm recovery with the qualified baseline. Do not ship an untested power-state workaround.
